## CoAct for Mental Health

All 18 scores rest on a single source, a conference proceedings paper written
by the project team [@casanovas2026]. Co-researchers with lived experience
helped formulate the questions and co-designed the chatbot, and a community
assembly approved 14 recommendations and presented them to Barcelona City
Council and the regional mental health pact. The research group ran data
collection and analysis, so the remaining stages were scored as contributed.
Because citizens took part in choosing the question (A1 = ◐), the case is
classed as participatory science. The verdict is partial: adoption of the
recommendations was not documented (C3 = ◐), and the funded project ended in
2022 without a documented hand-over (D1 = ◐). The scores have not been checked
against an independent source.
